title: 采样策略对比：greedy/temperature/top-k/top-p 同批 logits
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
logits = rng.standard_normal(10) * 2.0
print("固定 logits:", np.round(logits, 4))
greedy = int(np.argmax(logits))
def softmax(z, T=1.0):
    z = z / T
    m = np.max(z); e = np.exp(z - m)
    return e / e.sum()
p_t01 = softmax(logits, 0.1)
p_t2 = softmax(logits, 2.0)
temp_low = int(np.argmax(p_t01))
temp_high = int(np.argmax(p_t2))
def topk_sample(z, k):
    idx = np.argsort(z)[::-1][:k]
    sub = z[idx]; sub = sub - sub.max(); w = np.exp(sub); w /= w.sum()
    return int(idx[np.argmax(w)])
tk = topk_sample(logits, 3)
def topp_sample(z, p):
    order = np.argsort(z)[::-1]
    cs = np.cumsum(softmax(order, 1.0))
    cut = np.searchsorted(cs, p) + 1
    keep = order[:cut]
    sub = z[keep]; sub = sub - sub.max(); w = np.exp(sub); w /= w.sum()
    return int(keep[np.argmax(w)])
tp = topp_sample(logits, 0.9)
print("greedy 选:", greedy)
print("temp=0.1 选:", temp_low, " p=", round(float(p_t01[temp_low]), 4))
print("temp=2.0 选:", temp_high, " p=", round(float(p_t2[temp_high]), 4))
print("top-k=3 选:", tk)
print("top-p=0.9 选:", tp)
print("T=0.1 最大概率:", round(float(p_t01.max()), 4), " > T=2.0:", round(float(p_t2.max()), 4))
